inputs.description: A single readable pirate RPG ability or item icon per image. Vary the alternatives across four subjects: a clenched fist coated in polished black metal with silver glints; an eye with a glowing crimson iris and perception rings; a fragmented crown with black and crimson lightning; a closed indigo book bound in silver with a luminous violet clasp. Each image contains exactly one complete centered subject, bold single-color black outline, low detail, limited navy crimson silver violet palette, fully painted dark navy miniature background. No sheets, grids, text, labels, frames or multiple icons in one image.

selection_authority: User explicitly delegated choosing the best variants; native32 retry separately approved.
verification: All 64 PNG dimensions verified. Both candidate contact sheets inspected. Four selected themes readable, one icon per image, dark navy backgrounds, no text. Selected PNGs copied unchanged to runtime.
local_assembly: icons-sheet.png joins the four selected native32 icons into a lossless 4x1 preview; no resized final assets.
